trigger_condition.state_trigger: Input tensors to torch.einsum have requires_grad=True and are later modified in-place before backward.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Backward pass runs after in-place modification of autograd-tracked tensors.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: requires_grad=True tensor used in torch.einsum; in-place modification or reuse in another differentiable operation occurs before backward.

bug_oracle.description: Autograd detects an in-place modification of a requires_grad tensor used in torch.einsum and raises an exception during backward.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Apply in-place mutations such as add_, copy_, sub_, or zero_ to einsum operands or outputs after the forward call and before backward.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct tensors with requires_grad=True and varied shapes, dtypes, layouts, and aliasing relationships to use as torch.einsum operands.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Use einsum equations where outputs may alias inputs, and enforce requires_grad=True to expose autograd graph mutation.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.einsum with requires_grad tensors, apply an in-place mutation or reuse an operand in another differentiable operation, then call backward.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare backward behavior and gradients against a reference execution without in-place mutation; flag autograd exceptions or gradient mismatches.
